name: v1.82.0 - libtmux 0.68.0
body:
tmuxp 1.82.0 updates libtmux to 0.68.0. When an earlier entry in a pane's `shell_command` list closes the pane before a later entry runs, loading the workspace now raises [`TmuxObjectDoesNotExist`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.exc/#libtmux.exc.TmuxObjectDoesNotExist) instead of ignoring the missing pane.

## Highlights

### Sending a `shell_command` to a closed pane raises `TmuxObjectDoesNotExist`

`WorkspaceBuilder` sends each pane's `shell_command` entries through [`Pane.send_keys()`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.pane/#libtmux.Pane.send_keys). When an earlier command (such as `exit`) closes the pane before a later entry runs, loading the workspace now raises [`TmuxObjectDoesNotExist`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.exc/#libtmux.exc.TmuxObjectDoesNotExist) instead of dropping the later command.

Previously, the second command was dropped once `exit` closed the pane:

```yaml
panes:
  - shell_command:
      - cmd: exit
        sleep_after: 0.2
      - cmd: echo unreachable
```

Put `exit` last instead (or set `remain-on-exit` to keep the pane open):

```yaml
panes:
  - shell_command:
      - cmd: echo runs first
      - cmd: exit
```

### libtmux 0.68.0

tmuxp now requires libtmux `~=0.68.0` (was `~=0.67.1`). [libtmux 0.68.0](https://github.com/tmux-python/libtmux/releases/tag/v0.68.0) raises [`TmuxObjectDoesNotExist`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.exc/#libtmux.exc.TmuxObjectDoesNotExist) on closed panes, windows and sessions (including from [`Pane.capture_pane()`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.pane/#libtmux.Pane.capture_pane) and [`Pane.send_keys()`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.pane/#libtmux.Pane.send_keys)), raises [`VersionTooLow`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.exc/#libtmux.exc.VersionTooLow) from foreground [`Server.run_shell()`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.server/#libtmux.Server.run_shell) on tmux 3.3a and 3.4 where tmux keeps the output in copy mode, reuses windows by index or target in [`Session.new_window()`](https://libtmux.git-pull.com/api/libtmux.session/#libtmux.Session.new_window) with `select_existing=True`, and makes `expand_formats` the one parameter name for tmux's `-F`.

See the [changelog](https://tmuxp.git-pull.com/history/) for the full list.

## What's Changed
* libtmux 0.68.0 by @tony in https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp/pull/1112


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tmux-python/tmuxp/compare/v1.81.0...v1.82.0
